# normalize_binary.normalize_binary { #survey_cleaner.normalize_binary.normalize_binary }

```python
normalize_binary.normalize_binary(response)
```

Convert response to binary format (0 or 1).

Takes in a response such as True or False, T or F,
Yes or No and converts it to a normalized binary
format of 0 or 1.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type             | Description                                                                                                                                                                                               | Default    |
|----------|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| response | (bool, str, int) | The responses that must be normalized are: - Boolean: True, False - String: "T", "F", "Yes", "No", "True", "False" (case insensitive) The responses that don't have to be normalized are: - Integer: 0, 1 | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                          |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------|
|        | int    | 0 or 1; the normalized binary format |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> normalize_binary(True)
1
>>> normalize_binary("No")
0
>>> normalize_binary("T")
1
>>> normalize_binary(1)
1
>>> normalize_binary("False")
0
```
